sql: SELECT *, topic(4) AS sensor_id, topic(2) AS site_id, concat('', timestamp()) AS timestamp FROM 'ctm365/+/electrical/+'
description: Electrical gateways publish to ctm365/<site>/electrical/<datacard-id>. One item per message in ctm365_telemetry, keyed by the datacard ID; channel N is properties.SensorN x 0.1 = deg C rise.
